feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 14 September 2026 5:02pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 14 September 2026 at 4:45pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over the near continent and low pressure near Iceland as a waving frontal zone affects the British Isles.


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6, occasionally 7 at first, veering west 4 to 6 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate from late evening until tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Areas of mist and isolated fog patches, then rain spreading from the west this evening, turning heavy at times. Becoming mainly fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor or very poor in places. Becoming mainly good overnight.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or northwest 4 to 6, backing west or southwest 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.
